checks.command: ProformaTest::test_two_concurrent_issues_open_one_proforma failed; stashed this branch's diff and reran on clean base e2b7a25: same failure. Root cause probe (standalone issuer subprocess against t67): 'PHP Fatal error: Allowed memory size of 134217728 bytes exhausted … in object-cache.php' — the test's spawned processes read the CLI php.ini (128M) while the test process gets 2048M from phpunit.integration.xml.dist, so the winner died after taking the lock and its buffered stdout was lost (the pair read as '', 'REFUSED …').
